_readme: From News Desk, homepage-feed.md (26 Nov 2026). PREVIEW ONLY, pending Sam's approval. Each line has its source; unconfirmed items left out.

items.t: Lynk said it sent a text from a low-Earth-orbit satellite to an ordinary mobile phone on this date; the company announced the test on 18 March 2020.
Apple switched on Emergency SOS via satellite on the iPhone 14 lineup in the US and Canada, so users can message emergency services when there is no cellular or Wi-Fi coverage.

AST SpaceMobile announced that it had completed two-way voice calls from its BlueWalker 3 satellite to unmodified smartphones, including a call from the Midland, Texas area to Rakuten in Japan over AT&T spectrum.
SpaceX launched the first six Starlink satellites with Direct to Cell capability, at 7:44pm Pacific Time from Vandenberg Space Force Base (21 Starlink satellites in total on the flight).

The FCC adopted its Supplemental Coverage from Space framework (FCC-24-28), setting rules for satellite operators and terrestrial mobile providers to use certain flexible-use mobile bands to fill coverage gaps; the item was released on 15 March 2024.
One NZ began rolling out Satellite TXT, a nationwide Starlink Direct to Cell text service, to customers on eligible phones and plans at no extra cost.
KDDI started au Starlink Direct across Japan, a direct-to-cell service for text messaging, location sharing and emergency alerts, free for the time being to au customers.

T-Mobile launched T-Satellite commercially in the United States, available from that day to T-Mobile and non-T-Mobile customers for text and emergency use, with app access said to follow in October 2025.
Kyivstar made Starlink Direct to Cell available to its subscribers in Ukraine, starting with SMS on compatible 4G Android smartphones.
Ofcom published its final statement enabling satellite direct-to-device services in UK mobile spectrum bands, completing the authorisation framework set out earlier in 2025.
Rogers launched Rogers Satellite commercially in Canada, with text messaging and selected apps including WhatsApp, Google Maps, AccuWeather, X and CalTopo.

Orange made Message Satellite available to consumers in mainland France: SMS and location sharing via Skylo when there is no mobile or Wi-Fi coverage (announced 18 November 2025; consumer start date given as 11 December).
Virgin Media O2 switched on O2 Satellite, a Starlink Direct to Cell service in the UK for messaging and app-based data on compatible phones.
The FCC authorised AST SpaceMobile to operate a 248-satellite constellation and to provide Supplemental Coverage from Space with mobile partners (DA-26-391).
Beeline Kazakhstan launched Starlink Mobile, a direct-to-cell service for compatible Android smartphones, the first such commercial service in Kazakhstan.
Orange switched off 2G in the last 43 departments of mainland France where it still ran; Mayotte is due by the end of 2026.
SFR began switching off 2G in large cities in mainland France (16–30 November), with the rest of the mainland due from 1 to 15 December 2026; SFR’s 3G is due at the end of 2028.
Iridium announced service activation for Iridium NTN Direct, a 3GPP NB-IoT and direct-to-device service running on Iridium’s existing low-Earth-orbit network and L-band spectrum.
